'''Kaal starport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kaal/Legends|Kaal]]. Despite the [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Office of Customs]] officially overseeing customs duties at the spaceport, the local constabulary carried out day-to-day operations. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Murahl]] operated as a [[Customs official/Legends|customs official]] at Kaal starport.<ref name="PSG" />
